integrity: Analytic proof and a reproducible finite checker are provided. Prior-work comparisons do not certify historical priority; independent validation has not been carried out.
scientific_limitations: Real functions with finite ordinary variation on the line, Gaussian L2 error, positive Mehler mixtures on [0,1] excluding identity. No assertion for Gaussian-weighted BV, dimension >1, negative correlations or signed mixtures. An unindexed equivalent may exist.
title: Sharp Gaussian variation error for positive mixtures of Mehler operators
